references.text: The account of how the Hivites from Gibeon deceived the Israelites into making a peace treaty with them, which is the background for why Gibeon was the only city to make peace with Israel
The Hivites are specifically mentioned as the people who lived in Gibeon
The king of Jerusalem attacks Gibeon because they had made peace with Israel, confirming that Gibeon was the exception
The Mosaic law on how the Israelites were to treat cities at war - offer peace first, but completely destroy the Canaanite cities
The explanation for why no other city sought peace - the Lord had hardened their hearts
The Hivites are mentioned among the seven peoples of Canaan whom the Israelites were to drive out
Later reference to the covenant with the Gibeonites and that they were Hivites
